messages:
Leo (Sales): Handing off BrightHarbor — closed $500k ARR, reserved Dedicated cluster in us-west-2, contract starts 2025-05-01. Main contact: Maya Patel (maya@brightharbor.com). Requirements: Okta SSO, EU data residency for analytics subset, embeddings export to their analytics pipeline. Current risk: customer asked to delay full POC to June, so adoption momentum is low. Renewal trigger at 11 months; flagged for follow-up.

Samira (CS): Thanks @Leo — looping in Mohit and Anita. I'll own onboarding. Proposed 4-week plan: week1 infra & connectivity, week2 data mapping & prompts, week3 eng integration, week4 enablement + train-the-trainer. Can we get their Okta sandbox SP metadata and a small pilot dataset? Also need contract tech annex.

Mohit (CSE): I can take SSO + private deploy work. Need SP metadata, certs, and any S3 endpoints for test data. Will open an internal infra ticket (INF-3281) to track EU routing + network work.

Anita (Support): I'll be the support lead for initial go-live and on-call during POC. Please forward any expected error patterns or sample logs so I can add them to the playbook. I'll draft an escalation matrix and run a simulated alert flow with Mohit.

Leo (Sales): Drive with contract & tech annex here: https://redwood.tools/drive/brightharbor/contract (placeholder). Maya said she can provide test S3 creds by EOD Friday.

Samira (CS): Setting kickoff Tue 2025-05-06 10:00 PT. @onboard-bot please create calendar invite and include Maya + Carlos.

onboard-bot: KICKOFF created — BrightHarbor • 2025-05-06T17:00Z. Invites sent to Maya, Leo, Samira, Mohit, Anita.

Leo (Sales): One more note on renewal risk: they've tied our usage to an internal KPI. Recommend monthly adoption reviews + an exec check-in in late Q3. Samira, can you define adoption metrics and red/yellow/green thresholds?

Samira (CS): Will add a dashboard with monthly MAU, tokens consumed, avg latency, and top 5 queries. Suggested thresholds: <50 MAU = red, 50–200 = yellow, >200 = green. I'll share the first dashboard export by next Friday.

Mohit (CSE): INF-3281 created: "BrightHarbor Okta + EU data routing" — https://redwood.internal/INF-3281 (placeholder). Tagging eng-oncall. Also: if EU-only processing is enforced, we may need a Dedicated region config toggle — will estimate impact.

Anita (Support): Support playbook draft here: https://redwood.docs/playbooks/brightharbor-support (placeholder). Includes escalation matrix, sample logs, and test alert steps. Feedback welcome.

Leo (Sales): Owner summary for the record: Samira = CS owner; Mohit = technical owner; Anita = support owner. Next steps: Samira to confirm kickoff + dashboard; Mohit to obtain SP metadata + complete INF-3281; Anita to finalize playbook; Leo to send test creds. Ping this thread for blockers.

Samira (CS): Got it. I'll follow up with Maya if creds aren't in by Thu. @Leo please cc Maya's PM on the kickoff email.

Leo (Sales): Added Carlos (Brightharbor PM) to the thread and invite. :thumbsup:

Mohit (CSE): Quick note — if they push for EU-only processing, I'll send a short cost & config delta by Monday so CS can set expectations.

Samira (CS): Marking account with "renewal-risk" label in CRM and scheduling monthly adoption check-ins. Thanks everyone :pray:
